description: Deliberate differences between a Rust toolkit family and the Python SDK schema it must stay callable by (sdk_conformance.rs). Key: <sdk type>/<tool>/<rule>. Each value says why the difference is safe or what owns it. An entry that no longer matches fails the gate.

exemptions.artifact/create_file/drops:filepath: BUG: the SDK's copy-an-existing-file mode (`filepath` = /{bucket}/{name}, used to copy images/PDFs from generate_image or attachments) is not implemented; the closed Rust schema refuses any create_file call that passes `filepath`, so saved agents that copy files fail.
exemptions.artifact/create_file/requires:filedata: BUG: same missing copy mode as drops:filepath — the SDK makes `filedata` optional because a `filepath`-only call copies an existing file; Rust requires `filedata`, so a copy call that omits it is refused.
exemptions.artifact/list_files/drops:include: BUG: the closed Rust list_files schema does not accept the SDK's `include` glob filter; a call passing it is refused instead of returning a filtered listing.
exemptions.artifact/list_files/drops:skip: BUG: the closed Rust list_files schema does not accept the SDK's `skip` glob filter; a call passing it is refused instead of returning a filtered listing.
exemptions.artifact/read_file/drops:end_line: BUG: the Rust read_file schema is closed (additionalProperties: false) and does not list `end_line`; a model or pipeline call that passes it (valid against the SDK schema) is refused before dispatch instead of reading a line range.
exemptions.artifact/read_file/drops:extra_params: BUG: the Rust read_file schema is closed (additionalProperties: false) and does not list `extra_params`; a model or pipeline call that passes it (valid against the SDK schema) is refused before dispatch instead of applying per-file-type read options.
exemptions.artifact/read_file/drops:is_capture_imag: BUG: the Rust read_file schema is closed (additionalProperties: false) and does not list `is_capture_image`; a model or pipeline call that passes it (valid against the SDK schema) is refused before dispatch instead of reading the file (models commonly pass the default `false` explicitly, so even plain reads can fail).
exemptions.artifact/read_file/drops:page_number: BUG: the Rust read_file schema is closed (additionalProperties: false) and does not list `page_number`; a model or pipeline call that passes it (valid against the SDK schema) is refused before dispatch instead of reading one page of a document.
exemptions.artifact/read_file/drops:sheet_name: BUG: the Rust read_file schema is closed (additionalProperties: false) and does not list `sheet_name`; a model or pipeline call that passes it (valid against the SDK schema) is refused before dispatch instead of reading one spreadsheet sheet.
exemptions.artifact/read_file/drops:start_line: BUG: the Rust read_file schema is closed (additionalProperties: false) and does not list `start_line`; a model or pipeline call that passes it (valid against the SDK schema) is refused before dispatch instead of reading a line range.
exemptions.google_places/find_near/requires:target: Safe: the SDK schema marks `target` optional (default null) but the SDK method `find_near(self, current_location_query, target, radius)` takes `target` as a required positional, so an SDK call without it already fails with a missing-argument error; Rust only refuses it earlier with a clear schema error.
exemptions.postman/update_request_body/requires:bod: Safe: the SDK schema marks `body` optional (default null) but `update_request_body(self, request_path, body, **kwargs)` requires it and calls `body.get(...)`, so an SDK call without a body already fails; Rust refuses it up front instead.
exemptions.rally/update_artifact/requires:entity_ty: Safe: the SDK schema marks `entity_type` optional but `update_entity` raises ToolException('Please define entity type ...') when it is missing, so no SDK call without it ever succeeded; Rust refuses it at the schema instead.
